findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-201.11 Floors, Walls, and Ceilings. Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE. 

The corner strip in the dry storage room nearest to the door was observed with the Nudo board pulling away and exposing a gap in the corner. The PIC was shown and instructed to reseal the corner so that it is smooth and easily cleanable. Ensure that all facilities are maintained smooth and easily cleanable at all times.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.citation_text:
2-301.12(B) Cleaning Procedure. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use the following cleaning procedure in the order stated to clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms, including surrogate prosthetic devices for hands and arms: (5) Immediately follow the cleaning procedure with thorough drying using a method as specified under § 6-301.12.

An employee was observed to wash their hands and use their bare hands to turn off the faucet. This was discussed with the PIC and they are instructed to review hand washing procedures with all staff. Ensure hand washing takes place correctly at all times.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.citation_text:
2-301.14 When to Wash. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms as specified under § 2-301.12 immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including working with exposed FOOD, clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and:(H) Before donning gloves to initiate a task that involves working with FOOD.

An employee was observed to move from taking an order and donned gloves prior to food handling. Education was conducted and the PIC instructed to review hand washing with staff and monitor hand washing to ensure it takes place at all times that it is needed. Ensure hand washing is taking place at all required times in the facility.

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.citation_text:
3-302.11(A)(1) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (1) Separating raw animal FOODS during storage, preparation, holding, and display from: (b) Cooked READY-TO-EAT FOOD.

Raw eggs are observed over cheese in the front prep cooler in the facility. The PIC was shown and moved the items to correct. Ensure that foods are stored according to their cooking orders in coolers at all times in the facility.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 

A floor tile is damaged/missing between the fryers and adjacent freezer near to the wall. Grease and food debris is observed in this location at this time. This location needs repaired to allow for effective cleaning. Repair/replace the tile prior to the next routine inspection. Ensure that the facility is maintained in good repair at all times.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.citation_text:
2-301.14 When to Wash. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms as specified under § 2-301.12 immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including working with exposed FOOD, clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and: (H) Before donning gloves to initiate a task that involves working with FOOD.

Multiple employees were observed to change gloves and change tasks (to food handling) without hand washing. Education was conducted with the PIC and should be passed on to all employees moving forward. Hand washing is the most important method to preventing foodborne illnesses being spread and should be enforced at this facility. Ensure when to hand wash education is passed on to all staff at the facility.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment:
(REPEAT x2) 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Multiple pans both in use and on the storage shelves do not appear to have been completely cleaned when washed. Remaining sticker residue and stickers are still observed at the time of this inspection. The PIC is instructed to have the dishes re-cleaned period to the follow up being conducted on Monday.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria.

The sani buckets in the facility do not register on the inspector test strips at the beginning of the inspection. The PIC indicated that any time that they put the wiping cloths into the solution the concentration drops quickly. A bit of investigation was completed by the inspector using different buckets and cloths. It appear that the temperature of the initial solution is not allowing for an effective mixing of the chemicals. When both hot and cold water was turned on equally the solution produced regular concentrations of Quat in solution. These should be verified on an ongoing basis and the chemical company consulted to ensure longevity of the system, but this appears to have corrected the issue. The bubbles from the initial mixing also appear to be giving false readings when contacted by test strips. All of this has been discussed with the PIC and the buckets remade.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-501.111: PREMISE shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. 

Approximately 9 drain flys/gnats are observed flying and on the walls in the corner behind the fountain drink machine. This is a reduction in the previously observed flies but is not sufficient for considering the situation resolved. The PIC was shown and instructed to clean the area and facility sufficiently to not provide an enticing location for pests to propagate. No obvious locations are currently observed for enticement and no specific harborage location is noted at this time. Contact pest control for maintenance. Fly strips were also discussed during this inspection. They cannot be placed in locations that pose a concern for contamination for foods and food contact surfaces.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.14: FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including (A)-(I) any activities that may have contaminated the hands.  

Multiple employees are observed to either change or don gloves without hand washing throughout the inspection. Education was conducted with the PIC during this inspection. They are instructed to re-educate staff and be vigilant in ensuring that hand washing takes place at all times that hand washing needs to happen.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

1) A knife is stored on the magnetic rack to the left of the walk in cooler and is soiled. The PIC was shown and moved the knife to dish for cleaning. Ensure that all food contact surfaces are cleaned prior to storage moving forward.  2) (REPEAT) Pans in storage that are ready for use are observed to have not been fully cleaned prior to storage. Both sticker remains as well as glue (still sticky) are observed on the stored pans. The PIC was consulted and the items moved back to dish for re-cleaning. Ensure that all pans are completely cleaned prior to storage at all times.
